note: Literature indicates seizures vary markedly across cohorts and may be enriched in specific missense variants compared to loss-of-function variants.

evidence.text: Prior cohorts reported seizure frequencies such as 40% in Iwasawa et al., while broader cohorts evaluating missense vs loss-of-function variants observe that missense variants confer more severe symptoms.

source.title: Comprehensive Clinical Characteristics, Longitudinal Adaptive Functioning, and Electroencephalogram Activity in MAPK8IP3‐Related Neurodevelopmental Disorder
source.quote: However, Iwasawa (2) reported a higher prevalence of hypertonia (80%) and seizures (40%) … Missense variants were associated with more severe symptoms than LOF variants.

evidence.text: Seizures were noted specifically in individuals with NEDBA harboring particular variant classes rather than uniformly across all variant types.

source.title: Characterization of a novel inherited splice-site variant in MAPK8IP3 expands the genetic and phenotypic spectrum of neurodevelopmental disorders
